rationale: The most likely majority opinion is a Roberts assignment to himself to implement his proposed narrow, administrable rule: judges may resolve disputed exhaustion/unavailability facts for PLRA gatekeeping, with explicit non-preclusive effect on merits issues. Sotomayor is the most likely dissenter (possibly with Jackson joining or writing separately) to emphasize Beacon Theatres/Dairy Queen’s functional jury-displacement concern when exhaustion facts overlap with § 1983 merits.
